_comment: Both abilities searched the wrong zone with the wrong test and then acted on the wrong card. The first ("put an arrow card FROM YOUR HAND face up into your arsenal") was SEARCH_DECK -- the deck, not the hand, and a tutor rather than a move -- and its target was not read at all. The second identified a face-down arrow with REF_PITCH_IS pitch:"face_up", a condition about pitch COLOUR that is never the string "face_up", so the filter matched nothing; FLIP_REF read no target and defaulted to a ref nothing had set, so nothing was flipped; and the aim counter then RE-SEARCHED for "a face-up arrow in arsenal" instead of taking the one just flipped, so it could land on an arrow that was already face up. "If you do" falls out for free: with nothing flipped no ref is recorded and the counter has no target.
